exceptions_summary_unavailable_text: Refresh to check the latest totals. Your issue list is still available.
exceptions_connections_unavailable_text: Your issues are still shown. Refresh to check your connections.
exceptions_no_connections_text: Connect a commerce system so Luma can start checking your operations. {link}
exceptions_no_data_text: Luma hasn’t read data from a connected system yet. Issues appear here after the first read.
exceptions_empty_filtered_text: Change or clear the filters to see more issues.
exceptions_empty_needs_you_text: All open includes issues Luma is investigating, fixing or checking.
exceptions_empty_view_title: No open issues in this view
exceptions_pagination_total: {count, plural, one {{count, number} issue} other {{count, number} issues}}
exceptions_detail_denied_text: This issue is missing or you no longer have access.
exceptions_detail_error_text: Luma couldn’t confirm the current investigation. Refresh before relying on these findings.
exceptions_moved_title: This issue has left the current view
exceptions_moved_text: Its state or need for attention changed. It stays open here while you finish reading.
exceptions_placeholder_text: Review the details and choose your next step.
exceptions_shadow_title: Test a Workflow on this issue
exceptions_progress_failed_text: Refresh to load the latest state of this issue.
exceptions_history_failed_stale: Showing the history loaded earlier. The current review is shown separately.
exceptions_history_failed_text: The current review is shown separately.
exceptions_resolution_changed: The proposed change was updated. Review the new details before approving.
exceptions_resolution_check_failed: Luma couldn’t check the current conditions. Try again.
exceptions_resolution_no_receipt: Luma hasn’t recorded this decision yet. It may still be processing. Check again before you do anything else.
exceptions_resolution_offline_text: Decisions are paused until Luma can confirm the current state of this issue.
exceptions_resolution_unavailable_text: Luma couldn’t confirm the current approval rules and progress. Refresh before making a decision.
exceptions_receipt_approve_text: Luma recorded your approval. Applying the change and confirming the outcome are tracked separately.
exceptions_receipt_reject_text: The proposal was rejected. The issue stays open for follow-up.
exceptions_receipt_escalate_text: The issue was escalated for further review.
exceptions_resolution_checking_text: Luma is reading the latest data before you continue.
exceptions_resolution_expired_text: The proposal or its supporting evidence has expired. Approving needs a new proposal based on fresh evidence. Refreshing this page doesn’t extend the deadline.
exceptions_decision_not_permitted: You can’t make this decision anymore. Refresh to see the current options.
exceptions_decision_needs_proposal: This decision needs a current proposal that passed the approval rules. Refresh and try again.
exceptions_decision_error_session: Your session expired. Sign in again to review this issue.
exceptions_decision_error_permission: You no longer have permission to make this decision.
exceptions_decision_error_missing: This issue or decision is no longer available.
exceptions_decision_error_conflict: The proposal or issue changed. Review the current state before deciding again.
exceptions_decision_error_invalid: Luma couldn’t accept the decision. Check the reason and the current proposal.
exceptions_decision_error_unclear: Luma couldn’t tell whether your decision was recorded and is refreshing the current state. Check if it was recorded before you do anything else.
exceptions_refresh_unavailable: Luma couldn’t check the latest conditions. Nothing was approved. Try again shortly.
exceptions_field_freshness_description: Current only while the investigation’s evidence is still valid. Out of date and unknown evidence is never shown as current.
exceptions_field_waiting_since_descripti: When the issue started waiting on a person. Issues that wait on nobody have no value.
exceptions_board_note: Issues change state only through checks and decisions, so cards can’t be moved between columns.
